description: This Java class 'SqlLatestInsertTsRepository' handles batch update and insert-or-update operations for timestamped key-value entities in a SQL database, specifically for the latest timestamp data in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: SqlLatestInsertTsRepository
classes.description: Repository class for inserting and updating latest timestamp key-value entities in SQL database, with configurable update conditions based on timestamp.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes SQL query strings based on configuration after construction.

methods.name: setOnBatchUpdateValues
methods.description: Sets parameters for batch update PreparedStatement for a list of TsKvLatestEntity objects.

methods.name: setOnInsertOrUpdateValues
methods.description: Sets parameters for insert or update PreparedStatement for a list of TsKvLatestEntity objects.

methods.name: getBatchUpdateQuery
methods.description: Returns the SQL query string for batch update.

methods.name: getInsertOrUpdateQuery
methods.description: Returns the SQL query string for insert or update.
